title: Russian DNA phantom experiments

tellings.quote: In the 1990s, Russian scientists described something even more bizarre. In their so-called DNA phantom experiments

plain: In the 1990s, Russian scientists are said to have described something strange in what were called the "DNA phantom" experiments. Michels mentions this himself, without naming a source, in an episode on UFOs and the history of human experiments by drug companies, and calls it "even more bizarre" than what came before. In this line he gives the name of the experiments and nothing more about what was found.
